title: Grammar: Choose the pronoun, then place it before its verb
subtitle: A2 · Unit 8: Ask, answer and follow up at work or school

steps.title: Choose the pronoun, then place it before its verb
steps.body: A direct object answers 'what?' or 'whom?' after the verb. If the noun is already clear, French can replace it with le, la or les. The pronoun normally sits before the verb it belongs to.

steps.title: Notice the verb forms in project messages. The object pronoun then replaces the repeated document: Nadia le relit; le comité la reçoit.
rows: The instructor asks for the outline.
Are you handing in the file Thursday?
Je joins la liste au dossier.
I attach the list to the file.
Le comité reçoit la version finale.
The committee receives the final version.
Le plan doit être prêt vendredi.
The outline must be ready Friday.

steps.title: The pronoun matches the noun replaced, not the speaker. Before a vowel sound, le and la shorten to l'.
Choose the pronoun, then place it before its verb
steps.body:
• Use le for one masculine direct object, la for one feminine direct object, and les for plural objects of any gender.
• Place the pronoun before a conjugated verb: je le relis; elle la corrige; nous les classons.
• With aller + infinitive, place it before the infinitive: je vais le relire; nous allons les classer.
• Before a vowel sound, le and la become l': la note → je l'envoie. The noun's gender is still the way you choose the pronoun.
• With a simple negative, ne and pas go around the conjugated verb: je ne le trouve pas. In your notes, replace the same noun in three sentences; then retrieve them without looking.

steps.explain: Compte rendu is masculine singular, so replace it with le.
Version is feminine singular, so use la.

steps.prompt: Les fichiers ? Sam va ___ classer par date.
steps.explain: Fichiers is plural, and the pronoun goes before the infinitive classer.

steps.prompt: Le plan ? Je vais ___ organiser demain.
steps.explain: Plan is masculine singular, so use le; it shortens to l' before organiser.
